name: BERTomelo-ModernBERT-Base-v1
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from answerdotai/ModernBERT-base (config.json max_position_embeddings 8192). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder, alternating local (128) and global attention (every 3rd layer)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of answerdotai/ModernBERT-base, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.136 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-05-06. CAVEAT: the card says BERTomelo is 'pretrained from scratch' on ClassiCC PT (386.48B tokens) with a ModBERTBr tokenizer — so the ModernBERT rows are an architecture-matched baseline, not a parent checkpoint, even though base_model tags answerdotai/ModernBERT-base. The comparison is therefore a from-scratch Portuguese model against English ModernBERT, which explains the size of the NER gap. Six-seed means with std; card prints fractions, stored as percentages. Task tagged embedding: the card evaluates STS/RTE/NER after task heads, not retrieval.

benchmarks.name: ASSIN 2 Pearson
benchmarks.config: Card table 'Aggregated results (Mean +- Standard Deviation)': BERTomelo-Base 0.8375 vs row 'ModernBERT' 0.7730. Card prints Pearson as a fraction; stored as percent (x100). Mean over 6 seeds, 3-epoch early stopping, hyperparameters from Optuna on one seed.
